claims.value: Cohere Labs Aya Vision 32B is an open weights research release of a 32-billion parameter model with advanced capabilities optimized for a variety of vision-language use cases, including OCR, captioning, visual reasoning, summarization, question answering, code, and more. It is a multilingual model trained to excel in 23 languages in vision and language.
